answer.justification: This is reactive arthritis following bacterial gastroenteritis, with the classic triad of arthritis, conjunctivitis, and prior infection. Achilles tendon tenderness at its insertion (enthesitis) is a characteristic finding in reactive arthritis. Other options suggest other conditions: Lyme disease (erythema migrans), disseminated gonococcal infection (tenosynovitis), or Crohn's disease (abscess).
